name: czl-guatai
description: Fortune telling and hexagram casting as a real workbench: a bundled astronomy and calendar engine computes four-pillar BaZi charts, Zi Wei Dou Shu palaces, Plum Blossom and Six-Line hexagrams, tarot spreads and almanac date candidates, then reads each chart into checkable structure, stated limits and concrete next actions.

displayDescription.en: Real fortune telling and hexagram casting: BaZi, Zi Wei, Six-Line, Plum Blossom, tarot and date selection, every chart engine-computed and read into evidence plus next steps.
displayDescription.zh: 会算命也会算卦：八字、紫微、六爻、梅花、塔罗、择日，盘面由引擎真算，解读给依据和动作。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我算个命，排八字盘看看我的结构和今年该注意什么
defaultInitPrompt.en: Read my fortune — cast my BaZi chart and tell me my structure and what to watch this year
